quote: We are interested in evaluating different decoding strategies against a set of metrics that reflect the complexity of the different skills required to successfully solve multimodal referential games. Linguistic Quality: We compute the percentage of games with at least one repeated question, the overall number of unique words used by the model and, in line with the observations in , the number of rare words generated by the model, defined as those words that appear fewer than 20 times in the training set. Visual Grounding: To quantify the rate of object hallucination in the generated dialogues, we compute the CHAIR metric . Informativeness: To study the informativeness of the generated questions, we report the raw accuracy of the model in guessing the target object after each dialogue turn and at the end of the dialogue.
